result.topic_en: Riemann relates the four boundary-integral quantities (a,b), (b,c), (c,d), (d,a) of a hypergeometric-type integral to P-functions in the cross-ratio x, and derives the linear connection formulas between the branches at x and at 1-x.

methods.what: Möbius transformation sending four points to 0,1,1/2,∞ and cross-ratio variable
Linear relation among the four contour integrals between singular points (Cauchy theorem / monodromy)
Expression of the integrals (a,b) etc. as power factors times P-function branches in x or 1-x
Choosing the multiplier k to eliminate one integral, giving a three-term relation
Connection formula expressing branch at 1-x via branches at x
Reparametrisation by exponent differences λ, μ, ν
Connection formula in terms of λ, μ, ν with cosines
